[32543 3D Animation | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

This subject delves into key aspects of integrating 3D computer animation technology into interactive productions like a game or animated short output. It offers you the chance to master a leading game engine software focusing on advanced extensions for 3D animation. You'll learn the principles and practices of pre-production, practical realisation, code integration and post-production in animation projects. The subject is project-oriented, allowing you to create your own animation sequence or interactive game experience from concept to completion.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[32543 3D Animation | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Demonstrate an understanding of the theory of the design and production of 3D digital animation. (C.1)
SLO2: Develop animation skills and the ability to look at motion analytically. Students should be able to break down movement into key positions and qualitatively understand the physics associated with this movement. (D.1)
SLO3: Gain a working knowledge of the processes and workflows associated with designing and rigging a basic character for 3D Animation. (D.1)
SLO4: Create a character-based 3D Animation from planning stage (storyboard) to final 3D rendered short. (C.1)
